velocity_label_permutation.description: Swap velocity labels between phase-detected pulsars
velocity_label_permutation.interpretation: Velocity-label permutation requires at least two robust phase detections. The current Parkes/PPTA set has only one, so sign-label specificity is a follow-up test.

phase_scramble.description: Randomize epoch phase-closure angles and compare circular concentration
phase_scramble.interpretation: J0437 epoch phase closure is more concentrated than 100.0% of uniform circular phase scrambles (p = 0.0000).

pre_alignment_diagnostic.description: Epoch phase-closure distribution before any velocity weighting
pre_alignment_diagnostic.interpretation: J0437 has coherent non-zero phase closure before velocity-domain weighting.

blind_freeze_record.description: Prove ψ was frozen before velocity labels decoded
blind_protocol: 1. Pulsar names hidden during initial analysis
2. ψ computed for anonymous pulsars (A, B, C...)
3. Results saved to results/ with timestamp
4. Only after ψ frozen: proper motions decoded from literature
5. Velocity vectors matched to frozen ψ values
blind_freeze_record.interpretation: The hash is computed from the actual Step 003 phase-closure values present at control runtime. This records, but cannot by itself prove, the external blind-analysis chronology.

wrong_velocity.interpretation: The primary phase-closure observable is extracted from complex secondary-spectrum phases before velocity weighting. Changing the velocity vector cannot change phase_closure_rad, so this is not a valid control for the primary signal.

conclusion: All 3/3 applicable velocity-direction controls passed on current Step 003 phase-closure products; 1 inconclusive and 1 not applicable controls are reported separately.
